claims.claim: The summons-content requirements apply except as otherwise required by statute.
claims.quote: (a) Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written pleading with the court in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The filing deadline stated in that direction is 30 days after service of the summons on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: For an act provided by law, the first day is excluded from the count.
claims.quote: The time in which any act provided by law is to be done is computed by excluding the first day,

claims.claim: The last day is included unless it is a holiday, in which case it is excluded.
claims.quote: and including the last, unless the last day is a holiday, and then it is also excluded.

claims.claim: If the last day is a holiday, the period extends through the next day that is not a holiday.
claims.quote: If the last day for the performance of any act provided or required by law to be performed within a specified period of time is a holiday, then that period is hereby extended to and including the next day that is not a holiday.

claims.claim: All day on Saturdays counts as a holiday for the last-day extension.
claims.quote: For purposes of this section, “holiday” means all day on Saturdays,

claims.claim: The cited form is Judicial Council form SUM-100, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 gives the defendant 30 calendar days after service of the summons and legal papers.
claims.quote:
You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court and have a copy
served on the plaintiff.

claims.claim: SUM-100 directs the defendant to file a written response at the court identified on the form.
claims.quote: to file a written response at this court

claims.claim: SUM-100 also directs the defendant to have a copy served on the plaintiff within that period.
claims.quote:
You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court and have a copy
